# hestiacp_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages a HestiaCP firewall rule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Rule action: `ACCEPT` or `DROP`.
- `port` (String) Port number or range, e.g. `80`, `443`, `8080:8090`. Use `0` for ICMP.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional label for the rule (no spaces).
- `ip` (String) Source IP or CIDR to match. Empty string means any source.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: `TCP`, `UDP`, or `ICMP`. Defaults to `TCP`.
- `rule` (String) Optional rule position number. Lower numbers are evaluated first.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
